# simpleaudit-docs

Documentation for simpleaudit-docs

> https://github.com/SushantGautam/simpleaudit

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/quickstart/): Run your first local audit using the CLI and core experiment classes.
- [Installation](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/installation/): Install dependencies and configure local model paths for offline auditing.
- [Architecture](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/architecture/): Understand the auditor, experiment, and result aggregation pipeline.
- [Key Ideas](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/key-ideas/): Learn how custom judges and scenarios define adversarial test cases.
